text: SHMI scores field’s management record 0 100: SHMI = 0.400 Cover + 0.317 OrgInput + 0.153 Diversity + 0.130 InvDist sub-index also runs 0 100. Cover: share days living plants unit’s growing non-growing seasons, set climate. month growing season mean temperature least 5 °C , unless unit irrigated, precipitation (mm) least twice temperature (°C). growing season counts 0.860 rest year 0.140. Organic Inputs: share years organic amendment grazing animals. Grazing counts every calendar year grazing period spans. Diversity: average number plant species per year (0 one species, 100 eight ). Placeholder mixtures “8-species mix” count many species. Inverse Disturbance: tillage intensity computed exactly USDA’s Tillage Disturbance Index Soil Carbon (T-DISC, version 1.1.1). cash crop defines crop interval; passes fall five tillage windows around planting; implements combine within window EPA soil-mixing model; interval rated intense window. unit also receives T-DISC’s designation: -till, reduced till conventional till. STIR records can scored intervals windows.
